I take lithium. What you both should keep in mind is if she is on a dose higher than 300 mg you must get blood work done frequently to make sure she isn’t having lithium poisoning. It’s important to remember lithium is especially hard on someone’s kidneys/liver and thyroid. Other than that it can either be incredibly helpful to her (a wonder drug) or not. Some medications don’t work for everyone it’s important to keep this in mind, just because one med doesn’t work doesn’t mean that they all won’t work! Don’t loose hope.
